name: Ultimate Product Badge for WooCommerce
author: ProgrammeLab

sections.description:
Ultimate Product Badge for WooCommerce is a powerful and easy-to-use plugin that allows WooCommerce store owners to add custom product badges to highlight key items in their store. Whether you want to mark products as “New Arrival”, “Limited Stock”, “Best Seller”, or with custom messaging, this plugin makes it simple and effective. Product badges are a proven way to draw customer attention and boost sales by enhancing product visibility and creating a sense of urgency.

Key Features ==💡

  • ⭐ Customizable Badges: Create and apply custom badges to highlight products with unique messages such as “Hot Deal”, “Limited Edition”, or any label you desire.
  • Pre-Designed Templates: Choose from a variety of professionally designed badge templates that fit seamlessly with your store’s design.
  • Intuitive Badge Placement: Easily position your badges anywhere on the product image to ensure maximum visibility.
  • Dynamic Badge Content: Set badges to display automatically for products on sale, newly added products, or based on stock availability.
  • Responsive Design: All badges are fully responsive and optimized for all devices, ensuring they look great on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Benefits for Store Owners

  • Increase Product Visibility: Make your best products stand out with eye-catching badges that grab attention.
  • Boost Sales and Conversions: Highlight discounts, new arrivals, and limited-time offers to drive urgency and boost purchases.
  • Flexible and Easy to Use: Customize badges without any coding knowledge. The intuitive interface allows you to create badges in minutes.

Who Should Use This Plugin?

  • WooCommerce store owners looking to increase sales through better product visibility.
  • Store managers who want to highlight special deals, promotions, and product features in a visually appealing way.
  • eCommerce businesses of all sizes that need an easy solution to differentiate products and influence buying decisions.

Installation ==⚙️

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-product-badge-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Product Badges to start creating your badges.

Support

If you encounter any issues or have any questions, please reach out via the support forum.
sections.faq:
Q: Does this plugin affect page load speed?

A: No, the badges are optimized for performance, and the plugin is designed to have minimal impact on your site’s loading speed.
